dialogues.speaker: Ylgr
dialogues.text: Quite smoothly. I've finished annotating the maps of Drunkard Gorge, Springvale and the surrounding areas...

dialogues.speaker: Ylgr
dialogues.text: Annotation is actually quite tiring, but it's also very satisfying... Are you interested in my work, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Ylgr
dialogues.text: If you are, please take these — it's some of the knowledge I've gained on my adventures. Someday, everyone in Mondstadt will use the maps I've made!

dialogues.speaker: Ylgr
dialogues.text: Ah! You scared the life out of me! You shouldn't sneak up on people when they're absorbed in something like that!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're the one doing the sneaking.

dialogues.speaker: Ylgr
dialogues.text: How dare you accuse me of sneaking!

dialogues.speaker: Ylgr
dialogues.text: I'm Ylgr, and you'd better remember that name because I'm about to go down in history as one of the greatest adventurers of all time!

response.speaker: Ylgr
response.text: Yeah, I mean I'm... not famous enough yet, so... Ugh, did you really have to ask that?

response.speaker: Ylgr
response.text: *sigh* If only I had a Vision. When will the gods finally recognize me?

response.speaker: Ylgr
response.text: With elemental power at my disposal, I would be able to carve out my own path...

response.speaker: Ylgr
response.text: I am surveying the mountains around Springvale and checking for discrepancies against an old map.

response.speaker: Ylgr
response.text: Obviously most geological features don't change even after millennia of transformation in the world... But still, existing documentation is vague and imprecise on the location of certain places...

response.speaker: Ylgr
response.text: Once my newly updated map of Mondstadt is finished, I'm sure it will become famous all over Teyvat!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you encountered anyone who looks like me?

dialogues.speaker: Ylgr
dialogues.text: Looking for someone? ...I'm sorry, I don't think your appearance rings a bell.

dialogues.speaker: Ylgr
dialogues.text: I've been checking maps of Mondstadt for discrepancies lately, so I've only had eyes for the mountains and the rivers.

dialogues.speaker: Ylgr
dialogues.text: A person needs to give their tasks their full attention, wouldn't you say?
